tables.label: aMainMenu_SlotFrameVramAddr
tables.doc: Main menu, save slot boxes: VRAM word address of the frame of each slot part (two entries per slot).

tables.label: aMainMenu_SlotFrameTileStart
tables.doc: Main menu, save slot boxes: first tile (name table word) of each frame part.

tables.label: aMainMenu_SlotInfoTextVramAddr
tables.doc: Main menu, save slot boxes: VRAM word address where the slot's text (name, date, ...) is written; also indexed by the slot drawing code in main_loop.asm.

tables.label: aMainMenu_SlotFrameRunLength
tables.doc: Main menu, save slot boxes: run length (tiles) of each frame part.

tables.label: sYearOrdinal_82F298
tables.doc: Year ordinal pairs (3 x [s16, s16]) used by the main menu date text; the JP release has no such table (label defined in src/code/region_targets.asm).

tables.label: aMainMenu_PalAnimLogoA
tables.doc: Palette animation of the title logo, part A: entries are `dl` = colour word (low 16 bits, BGR555) + duration in frames (high byte); `dw $FFFE` + `dl label` = loop.

tables.label: aMainMenu_PalAnimLogoB
tables.doc: Palette animation of the title logo, part B (same entry format as part A).

tables.label: aMainMenu_PalAnimItemHighlighted
tables.doc: Palette animation of a highlighted menu item (same entry format).

tables.label: aMainMenu_PalAnimItemNormal
tables.doc: Palette animation of a menu item that is not highlighted (same entry format).

tables.label: aMainMenu_PalAnimSlotHighlighted
tables.doc: Palette animation of the highlighted save slot (same entry format).

tables.label: aMainMenu_PalAnimSlotNormal
tables.doc: Palette animation of a save slot that is not highlighted (same entry format).
